game_concept: A quiz RPG set in Mt. Pyre – Charred Forest, a burnt forest at the foot of the mountain: the ash ranger must handle ember hounds while practicing data types & operators. Core idea – Divide Or Floor: Pick / or // to split ash bricks evenly among allies without leaving fractions.
theme: Mt. Pyre – Charred Forest: a burnt forest at the foot of the mountain
core_gameplay_loop: Inspect the circuit board, solve the CP1 station, and advance the signal through its gates.
secondary_mechanics: Hint tokens that reveal one line of code
player_objective: Print every even number from 18 through 34. Trace the update by 2 and the final failed condition. Test dataset 4: {}; {}.
controls: Drag the flowchart symbols into connected positions, then Check chart.
win_condition: Construct a complete chart that passes every executable input/output case.
lose_condition: The available unsuccessful chart checks are exhausted.
assets_style: Shared Kenney CC0 tile and audio assets with deterministic Canvas layouts; assets are not duplicated per game.
duplicate_check_notes: Unique combination of primary mechanic 'Divide Or Floor' (Week 2 slot 4), mission type 'Streak Challenge', and setting 'Charred Forest'. No other file shares this combination; games sharing the mechanic differ in mission/win condition and setting, and games sharing the setting use a different mechanic.

region.name: Mt. Pyre
region.mood: low war drums, rumbling bass and crackling fire effects

tutorial: Use terminator, input/output, process and decision symbols.
Test the chart with every example input.
source_player_objective: Chain 9 consecutive correct decisions about share to power up the ash ranger and open the smelter.
source_lose_condition: lives reach 0 (each wrong decision costs a life and resets the streak).
source_game_title: Divide Or Floor – Charred Forest Streak
hint: Follow the input through each operation. Compare every output, including negative inputs.
